header: Here, in one place, I decide what a selection does on the server: which of the answer paths of src/lib/nl2sql/omnibar.ts may run under each, and what to say when the chosen one has nothing. "auto" lets every path run (today). A chosen scope lets ONLY its own paths run: the line is never trafficked to the others, and a chosen scope that finds nothing says so (it does not fall through to the circulars). The management pages and their leading-action-word requests ("add new employee", "post circular") are always allowed: they only open for the words that ask for them, and each checks who is calling.
